caseNameFull: Julio Aybar v. The People of Porto Rico
summary: Appeals from the Supreme Court of Porto Rico.
attorneys: Mr. Jackson H. Ralston, Mr. F. L. Siddons and Mr. Willam E. Richardson for appellant., Mr. Paul Charlton and Mr. Foster V, Brown for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

As jurisdiction in this court does not appear from the records in these cases, the appeal in each case is dismissed for want of jurisdiction.

Mr. Paul Charlton and Mr. Foster V, Brown for appellees.
